# Book and Gin Society

> A book club in Wellington, New Zealand, that meets monthly, usually at Southward Distillery in Lyall Bay. There is no set book: members bring what they have been reading and discuss it. This site lists every book the club has discussed.

## Key facts
- Meets on the last Friday of every month, usually at Southward Distillery, Lyall Bay, Wellington, in person only
- Founded under a written charter signed in February 2025
- No assigned reading; members bring their own books
- Books are classified as Soft Fiction, Hard Fiction, Soft Non-Fiction or Hard Non-Fiction
- Each shelf entry names the member who brought the book; some are marked "Brought as a warning"
- Membership is by invitation
- Non-alcoholic drinks are always available

## Key pages
- [Shelf](https://bookandginsociety.com/shelf): every book discussed, by category
- [About](https://bookandginsociety.com/about): how the club works
- [The Minutes](https://bookandginsociety.com/minutes): monthly newsletter of books discussed
- [Rachel L](https://bookandginsociety.com/about/rachel): founding member and chairperson
